stops.title: The Garden at 120: a rooftop garden among the City towers
stops.travel_text: Getting there: about 26 min: walk to Waterloo station, then take the Tube or bus to Bank, Monument or Fenchurch Street station.
stops.approach: Go into Hogarth Court from Fenchurch Street or Fenchurch Avenue, pass an airport-style security check, and take the lift to floor 15.
stops.what: You step out 15 floors up into a garden of wisteria, roses and hydrangeas around a water feature, with the City's towers all around and views to the Thames and Tower Bridge.

stops.title: The whole of London from General Wolfe's hill, Greenwich Park
stops.travel_text: Getting there: about 41 min: walk to Monument or Tower Hill station, then take the Tube or bus to Cutty Sark DLR station.
stops.approach: Walk into the park and up the steep hill to the statue beside the Royal Observatory: about 15-20 min, the last part uphill.
stops.what: At the top, all of London opens up across the river: Canary Wharf, the Shard and St Paul's.
stops.best_text: Best: Late afternoon on a clear day
stops.rain_swap: The Uber Boat up the river from Greenwich to Battersea, by day, about 10 min away on foot.
